recipe.visualDefinition: A portrait-centric layout featuring a warm-toned, grainy photograph of a smiling man, topped by a structured horizontal header containing multi-tiered typography and a distinctive corner-tab logo element.
coreVisualRelationships: The subject's head is centered below a rigid, multi-layered typographic header.
Warm skin tones and a colorful patterned shirt contrast against a neutral, mottled background.
A dark horizontal bar separates the top header from the main image area.
The top-left corner features a high-contrast graphic tab that breaks the horizontal flow.
coreInvariants: Warm, earthy color palette with film-like grain.
Strict horizontal alignment of text in the upper third.
Condensed, uppercase sans-serif for the primary name display.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium close-up portrait, centered horizontally, filling the bottom two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and smile serve as the primary focal point, anchored by the heavy black bar above.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large name in the header, move down to the subject's face, and then to the patterned shirt details.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Mottled, out-of-focus background provides breathing room around the subject's head.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm browns and tans in the skin and background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black and white in the header bars and logo tab.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Teal, green, and red in the shirt's geometric pattern.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value in the white text areas; medium saturation in the shirt; low saturation in the background.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or synthetic digital colors.
Maintain a vintage 1970s film stock color profile.

letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke weight for the main name.
Extreme vertical compression in the secondary subtitle.
High-contrast serif for the corner numeric graphic.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The '20' features a large, elegant serif '2' with a teardrop terminal and a perfectly circular '0'.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Condensed bold sans-serif paired with widely-spaced light sans-serif and a classic high-contrast serif for branding.
graphicDevices: Rounded corner tab on the left

preserve: The wide letter-spacing of the bottom text line
avoid: Centering the portrait without the header

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the condensed, clean uppercase look of the main name.
Good for the widely-spaced subtitle text.
Matches the high-contrast serif style of the numeric logo.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a warm, grainy 1970s-style portrait of a man with a beard and patterned shirt against a mottled brown studio backdrop. Leave the top 30% of the frame clear for a graphic header.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a grey horizontal bar at the top, followed by a thin white bar. Place a large condensed sans-serif name in the grey bar. Place a widely-spaced light sans-serif subtitle in the white bar. Add a black rounded tab in the top-left corner with a large white serif number.

verificationChecks: Is the header divided into distinct color bands?
Is the main name in an all-caps condensed font?
Does the portrait have a visible film grain texture?
Is the bottom text line significantly more spaced out than the top?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of the mottled background
Width of the horizontal header bars
mustRedesign: Specific artist names and brand logos
The exact '20th Century Masters' trademarked logo lockup

avoid: Clashing bright colors in the background

postGenerationChecks: Check for consistent grain across the image and header.
Ensure the black bar doesn't obscure the subject's hair unnaturally.
Verify the spacing between the text tiers is even.
Confirm the corner tab is properly aligned with the top edge.
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + Multi-tier Horizontal Header + Condensed Sans-Serif + Wide-Tracked Subtitle + Corner Branding Tab
